svg.text: How the data flows: local AI simulation → S3 → Snowflake RAW → dbt (with Cortex AI) → production marts → Streamlit · dotted = planned next step
Data never leaves the laptop during simulation.
Benchmark for audience costs (not for these ads).
CLASSIFY_TEXT → which ad: A / B / C / D / general
8 segments × 4 ads · simulated beside real · low-sample flag (<5) · null not zero
Same code, separate schemas: dashboards never read a sandbox
• Least-privilege roles: LOADER writes RAW · TRANSFORMER reads RAW, builds ANALYTICS · REPORTER reads ANALYTICS only
• One XSMALL warehouse per job (load / transform / report), 60s auto-suspend · resource monitor: 20 credits/month, suspend at 100%
• AI stays inside the data boundary: local LLM for the simulation, Snowflake Cortex for enrichment; no data sent to outside AI APIs
• Cortex runs once per row in a materialized table; dashboards read stored results instead of re-calling the model
• Public repo uses placeholders: no account IDs, bucket names, keys or passwords · secrets scanned across full git history
• Known limits: 88 reactions · agreeable 7B personas · uneven ad exposure · 2017 benchmark is by audience only
